description: Connect to a MongoDB instance and get back a connectionId to pass to the other MongoDB tools. Each call establishes a new, independent connection — multiple connections can be active at the same time.

connectionName.description: Optional short label for the connection (stored slugified with a short suffix, e.g. "staging" becomes staging-<suffix>). Shown in connection listings; helpful for telling multiple connections apart.

connectionString.description: MongoDB connection string (in the mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// format)

name: connect
